column3: 1. Integrate protected areas and other effective area-based conservation measures, recognizing indigenous and traditional territories, where applicable, into broader landscape and seascape planning to improve, in accordance with national legislation, biodiversity outcomes, ecological representativeness and connectivity, through participatory and biodiversity-inclusive spatial planning processes, while recognizing and respecting the rights of indigenous peoples and local communities. [1 bis Identify and map, using best available science and, subject to free, prior and informed consent, as applicable, indigenous and local knowledge, ecological corridors, stepping-stones and other areas of particular importance for ecological connectivity, including for threatened and migratory species, and integrate this information into relevant national and subnational spatial planning policies, legislation, regulations and programmes, including for the designation and expansion of protected areas and other effective area-based conservation measures, recognizing indigenous and traditional territories, where applicable, paying particular attention to priority connectivity areas not yet integrated into such systems.
column4: 1. 根據國家立法，透過參與式且具生物多樣性包容性之空間規劃程序，將保護區與保育共生地（在適用情況下認可原住民族與傳統領地）整合至更廣泛的景觀與海域規劃中，以改善生物多樣性成果、生態代表性與連結性，同時認可並尊重原住民族與地方社區之權利。[1 bis 運用現有最佳科學，並在適用情況下，於符合自由、事先及知情同意之前提下運用原住民與地方知識，識別並繪製生態廊道、踏腳石及其他對生態連結性特別重要之區域，包括針對受威脅物種與遷徙物種，並將此資訊整合至相關之國家與次國家級空間規劃政策、立法、法規與方案中，包括用於指定與擴大保護區與保育共生地，在適用情況下認可原住民族與傳統領地，並特別關注尚未整合至此類系統之優先連結區域。

column3: 2. Promote the restoration of degraded ecosystems [within protected areas and other effective area-based conservation measures, recognizing indigenous and traditional territories, where applicable], and beyond, including buffer zones, ecological corridors, soil biodiversity[, [including] fungal biodiversity,8] and inland water ecosystems, with a view to restoring ecological integrity and ecological connectivity across landscapes and seascapes, including through the development of criteria for identifying priority restoration areas and approaches for measuring restoration success, ensuring inclusive and gender-responsive implementation of the restoration efforts, as appropriate.[2.bis Scale up ecological connectivity measures within currently under-represented ecosystems, including marine and island ecosystems, rivers, wetlands, estuaries and coastal zones, and seek, as appropriate, to align terrestrial ecological corridors with riverine and inland water networks, in support of restoring ecological integrity and connectivity across landscapes and seascapes.]
column4: 2. 促進退化生態系之復育 [於保護區與保育共生地內，在適用情況下認可原住民族與傳統領地]，以及其範圍之外，包括緩衝區、生態廊道、土壤生物多樣性[，[包括] 真菌生物多樣性，8] 及內陸水域生態系，以期復育跨景觀與跨海域之生態完整性與生態連結性，包括透過制定識別優先復育區域之標準及衡量復育成功之方法，並在適當情況下，確保復育工作之實施具包容性與性別回應性。[2.bis 擴大目前代表性不足之生態系（包括海洋與島嶼生態系、河流、濕地、河口及沿岸地帶）之生態連結性措施，並在適當情況下，設法使陸域生態廊道與河川及內陸水域網路相互配合，以支持復育跨景觀與跨海域之生態完整性與連結性。]

column3: 3. Incorporate the language, scope and timelines of Target 3 of the Framework across implementation of the programme of work, updating relevant timelines and terminology, and ensuring coherence with related processes carried out under the Convention on Biological Diversity, including the programme of work on Article 8(j) and other provisions of the Convention related to indigenous peoples and local communities to 2030.9 4. Strengthen guidance related to improving monitoring, reporting and evaluation systems for terrestrial, inland waters, coastal and marine ecosystems to improve the assessment of biodiversity outcomes, including in relation to ecological representativeness, connectivity, integrity, conservation effectiveness, management effectiveness, governance quality, species population trends and through the use of appropriately indicators of the monitoring framework for the Kunming- Montreal Global Biodiversity Framework,10 as well as disaggregated indicators, including, as appropriate, by ecosystem type and level of protection. 5. Enhance guidance related to the recognition, respect, promotion and protection of indigenous and traditional territories, where applicable, in the context of Target 3 of the Framework, in a manner consistent with the programme of work on Article 8(j) and other provisions of the Convention related to indigenous peoples and local communities. This encompasses differentiated approaches to ensure comprehensive protection, including for indigenous peoples in voluntary isolation and initial contact, in line with the principles of no contact, intangibility and precaution, in accordance with national circumstances. 6. Increase the uptake of practical frameworks, guidance, emerging innovative tools, case studies and national experiences, lessons learned
column4: 3. 在整個工作計畫之執行中，納入綱要目標 3 之用語、範圍與時程，更新相關時程與術語，並確保與《生物多樣性公約》下進行之相關程序保持一致，包括關於第 8(j) 條之工作計畫，以及公約中其他與原住民族與地方社區相關之規定，至 2030 年。9 4. 強化與改善陸域、內陸水域、沿岸及海洋生態系之監測、報告與評估系統相關之指引，以改善對生物多樣性成果之評估，包括與生態代表性、連結性、完整性、保育成效、管理成效、治理品質、物種族群趨勢相關之評估，並透過適當運用昆明－蒙特婁全球生物多樣性綱要監測架構之指標，10 以及分項指標，包括在適當情況下按生態系類型與保護程度分項之指標。5. 在綱要目標 3 之脈絡下，加強與認可、尊重、促進及保護原住民族與傳統領地（在適用情況下）相關之指引，其方式應與第 8(j) 條之工作計畫及公約中其他與原住民族與地方社區相關之規定一致。這包括採取差異化方法以確保全面保護，包括針對自願隔離與初次接觸之原住民族，並依據國家情況，遵循不接觸、不可侵犯及預防原則。6. 提高對實務架構、指引、新興創新工具、個案研究、國家經驗、經驗教訓
